articles.title: After Giving Away Thousands of Dollars in Cosmetics, Fortnite is Teasing a Big Reveal For Captain X, Its Mysterious Masked Treasure Man — With Fan Guesses Ranging From Mr Beast to Obama
articles.summary: Fortnite is teasing a big reveal for its upcoming December 5 live event, which will reveal the identity of mysterious new character Captain X. The game has previously employed big-name stars such as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson and Brie Larson to portray notable in-game characters, and appears to be…
body: Captain X made their debut at the beginning of Fortnite's current treasure-hunting mini-season, though their motives are currently unclear. As Fortnite's heroes hunt a fresh macguffin, Captain X has seemingly allowed them to make steady progress, while the game's story has suggested the character could also simply be letting players do their legwork instead, before swooping in to steal the prize.

Whether Captain X turns out to be friend or foe remains unclear, as does their relation to the game's wider storyline. This currently features a roster of surviving heroes from much of the game's past decade returning to face down Geno, Fortnite's uber Big Bad from the days when Epic Games' former creative boss Donald Mustard was still in charge of the storyline.
Should Geno actually be defeated, finally, will Captain X be revealed as the next major threat? Or perhaps they will be a new hero for players to follow, should Jonesy finally fall in battle?
points: Fortnite is teasing a big reveal for its upcoming December 5 live event, which will reveal the identity of mysterious new character Captain X.
Captain X made their debut at the beginning of Fortnite's current treasure-hunting mini-season, though their motives are currently unclear.

articles.title: Fable Is Looking A Lot Darker Than We Expected
articles.summary: Amid a modest 25th-anniversary celebration, Xbox dropped a new preview of the Fable reboot. This snippet — which runs for under four minutes — offers plenty of gameplay and a closer look at some of the ghoulish enemies you'll face, set in a slice of Albion that looks surprisingly grim compared to…
body: "The Hero of Briar Hill has entered the depths of Deepwood alongside Arden, a local Hero, to investigate why strange magical happenings have been troubling the people of Oakshire," the video synopsis reads. "Here, they cross a threshold where the natural magic of Deepwood appears corrupted by an outside force, and they discover hints as to who or what could be responsible."

One thing to note about this snippet of gameplay is that it's pulled from the PC build of Fable, with the settings cranked up to Ultra. It's a pretty good-looking glimpse of what you can expect from Fable next year, even if it feels different from its cheekier predecessors and more like a feudal action slice reminiscent of Control Resonant toward the end, with its red-hued aesthetic.

Of course, four minutes of Fable doesn't tell the whole story, and with the main campaign alone estimated to take 20 hours to finish, that doom-and-gloom feeling probably won't be present throughout the entire game.

articles.title: Microsoft Struggling to Fix Global System Outage Impacting Email Systems and More, Admits Initial Repairs 'Not Taking as Expected'
articles.summary: Microsoft is struggling to fix a prolonged systems outage that has hindered access to online services including Outlook and Teams. On the upside, AI tool Copilot has also been impacted.
body: For more than 12 hours, users around the world have been reporting an inability to access email accounts, instant messaging systems, and documents via OneDrive and Office365. No Xbox services are believed to be offline, however.

Microsoft was quick to acknowledge the problem and admit that it was suffering from issues with its server capabilities, with "elevated load across multiple regions." Attempts to solve this were initially unsuccessful, however, as the company reported its fixes were "not taking as expected."

"We've monitored the status of the changes applied to improve serviceability and confirmed they're not taking as expected," Microsoft said in a lengthy thread on X/Twitter. "We're identifying alternate workstreams that can be applied to increase capacity in the face of sustained traffic management imbalances."
Hours later, Microsoft seemed to have changed tack and was now trying to carve out the impacted servers completely as it struggled to make progress.

articles.summary: The first teaser for Gatto, Pixar's upcoming animated film, was released on Jun. 11, following a description of the movie's general plot and some cast members. Fans learned that Gatto is set in the Italian city of Venice, and it follows the adventures of a feral black cat named Nero, who's spent…
body: The story sounded promising, and the animation style was charming, to say the least. Fans were eager to get another mobster cat adventure movie. On Thursday, Nov. 12, Pixar published a 2-minute trailer that gives us a better look at each character in Gatto and dives deeper into the plot.

According to the trailer, after losing eight of his nine lives and coming down to a single whisker, Nero starts to question whether he's wasted them. When Rocco tells him to steal a street musician's violin, Nero discovers his love for music and forms a friendship instead. This is a turning point, and Nero realizes he must survive the dangers that lurk in Venice and find his purpose.

Written and directed by Enrico Casaroca and produced by Andrea Warren, Gatto is being developed by the same creators who made Luca (2021), a beloved Pixar film that was nominated for Best Animated Feature. Academy Award winner Dario Marianelli ( Atonement, Pride & Prejudice ) is in charge of the score. He is working alongside Slovak violinist Barbora Botošová.

articles.title: Will GTA 6 break the internet? UK broadband operator braces for impact, saying "GTA 6 has been on our radar for a long time"
articles.summary: As Grand Theft Auto 6 breaks pre-order records on the PlayStation and Xbox stores, and looks poised to break many more sales records once it launches next week, questions of whether it will also break the internet arise.
body: Major game releases register nationally for broadband use: we know this from an investigation into gaming downloads and how much they cost the environment we published in 2021. We also know that UK communications regulator Ofcom negotiates with gaming companies to try and avoid major game launches happening alongside major cultural occasions, such as sporting events, which are likely to spike broadband use. The network pipes can be clogged, and there's arguably never been a game as anticipated as GTA 6 to clog them.

For this reason, Openreach - the company that runs the largest broadband network in the UK - has been tracking Rockstar's latest game closely. "GTA 6 has been on our radar for a long time," Trevor Linney, Openreach's director for network technology, told Eurogamer. "We know from games like Fortnite and Call of Duty that a major release or update can drive huge amounts of data across the network, so it'll be fascinating to see just how much GTA moves the needle. Our network and teams are ready, and GTA 6 is certainly one we'll be watching for a new download record."

articles.title: 6 Nintendo Switch Special Editions With the Best Designs, Ranked
articles.summary: When a new console arrives, a lot of us rush out to buy one the minute we can afford to. At launch, there’s typically just one option, or sometimes a handful of choices with varying specifications. Personality isn’t a draw yet, beyond whatever’s standard. Over time, however, that inevitably changes.
body: Some consumers hold out for a special edition console, which might come with a game and special visual enhancements. Over the years, Nintendo has done a great job of delivering in this area, going back to the colorful “Play It Loud” versions of the original Game Boy and some tempting Nintendo 64 variants. More recently, Nintendo has offered several beautiful designs for the Switch, and just kicked things off on the Switch 2. Here are six of the best-looking special editions.

You might expect a lot of color from a special edition modeled after a game like Splatoon 3, and mostly that’s what you get (along with the OLED version of the hardware, for added brightness). The system’s base itself is white with gray print, featuring an intricate design that is enhanced by a splotch of bright yellow “paint” on its left portion. The base looks like it just got pegged by a paintball. The JoyCons, meanwhile, are vibrant tones of purple and blue on the left side, and green and yellow on the right, also with neat artwork. The effect is very pretty, even if you aren’t super familiar with the IP.

articles.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved is getting its own four-player version of the series' staple Firefight mode, for free, "this winter"
articles.summary: Last night, Xbox Game Studios and Halo Studios have announced a free update for the recently-released Halo: Campaign Evolved, which promises to add the four-player co-operative PvE mode, Firefight, to the game.
body: "For nearly two decades, Firefight has been a Halo favorite, challenging Spartans to team up, hold the line, and survive wave after wave of enemies," says Halo Studios director of competitive engagement Tahir Hasangjekaj said in a dedicated post on the Xbox website. "The tradition continues this winter as we add the four-player cooperative PvE mode to Halo: Campaign Evolved in a free update."

Though we don't have a release date for the update yet, Hasangjekaj does explicitly state "this Winter" as a window, and promises that we'll hear more information about the update at Halo Fest - due to run from 12th to 13hth December in Seattle, Washington. My money would be on a release around then, therefore.

"We're kicking things off tonight at Xbox FanFest, where attendees will be the first to jump in and experience Firefight across new maps and armed with plenty of weapons to help even the odds." It seems there's already a playable build of the mode, then.

articles.title: 5 Sci-Fi Book Trilogies Where Every Entry Is Perfect
articles.summary: Of course, not all sci-fi trilogies are created equal. Plenty start strong only to flame out in book two or three, while others admittedly take a while to get good. But there are plenty of perfect trilogies, too.
body: Trilogies are a popular book format for a reason. Apart from naturally satisfying the rule of three, they also naturally mimic the classic structure of a beginning, middle, and end. Trilogies allow writers to flesh out their worlds, creating enough breathing room for genre concepts and important events. The same logic is particularly true for science fiction. Dystopian sci-fi books like The Hunger Games use the trilogy structure to map out the painstaking moving parts of a rebellion, while the Broken Earth science-fantasy trilogy encompasses a massive supercontinent full of complex lore.
points: Of course, not all sci-fi trilogies are created equal.

articles.title: 'I stand by Jensen': Nvidia employees come out in support of Huang after resignation
articles.summary: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned from the company after he admitted to an affair on Sunday, and allegations of a second affair came out on Wednesday. Now there are reports of a potential third.
body: It's claimed that a longtime engineer at Nvidia took to an internal suggestion box this week to ask the Nvidia board to consider the company's employees before deciding whether or not to get rid of Huang. This note was made prior to his resignation.
However, over 1,600 comments have been left regarding this suggestion, the majority of which are apparently supportive of Huang. One says, "If you believe in the mission, bring back THE boss."
Another claims, "We are all humans and can make mistakes. Jensen did so many good things and he needs a second chance."

Notably, not all employees took to the suggestion box to air the same sentiment. One sent an email to the entire company saying, “I stand by Jensen. Not because I believe any person is infallible, but because I refuse to believe that standing for fairness must mean standing at a distance from someone whose leadership has meant so much to us.”

articles.title: The He Who Fights With Monsters Hardcover Books Are on Sale Before Black Friday
articles.summary: Amazon has kicked off its latest '3 for 2' sale on books ahead of Black Friday and there are some terrific new releases in there for LitRPG fans. If you haven't already scooped up the Dungeon Crawler Carl books, for example, now is a great time to do so for cheap.
body: The first He Who Fights With Monsters hardcover was released earlier this year and the third book will be arriving next week. This series is my overall favorite LitRPG and a great read if you love Dungeon Crawler Carl.

He Who Fights With Monsters is fairly well-known in the LitRPG community already. There have been a total of 13 books released so far and they are all terrific. Similar to Dungeon Crawler Carl, there's a lot of humor and pop-culture references sprinkled throughout a relatively fast-paced story. It definitely leans more fantasy than sci-fi, so expect a lot more magic and a less actual science.

The story follows Jason Asano as he wakes up inside a hedge maze in a magical world with new powers and absolutely no hair on his body. His determined and off-balance attitude to his strange new predicament helps him to survive the likes of cannibals, monsters, and even personal relationships with ease. All-in-all, a fantastic book with a morally conflicted main character that you can’t help but love the whole way through. His dark and mysterious powers only make the story all the more interesting.

articles.title: Horu is a sci-fi 4X RTS inspired by Star Wars: Empire at War in which spaceships are spellcasters who can summon black holes
articles.summary: Clicking a random link this morning, I was dazzled by the glare of a thousand laser batteries firing simultaneously. My ears trembled beneath the trundle of a million caterpillar tracks.
body: But then I realised that I wasn't looking at a live newsfeed, but merely the Steam page for Horu, a real-time 4X strategy game in which you can "command hundreds of thousands of units across land and space", in the summary of developer David "GlassBeaver" Nadaski. There's also a magic system, this being "the spice that makes your enemy's defeat bitter", which is a very genteel way to characterise glaciating a tank formation or conjuring a miniature blackhole.

In development for years, and running on a custom C++ engine, Horu is inspired by 2006 hybrid RTS Star Wars: Empire at War - good, not great, in the words of turncoat jankonaut Graham, and the subject of many mods. Horu's way of bettering Empire at War is seemingly to add a shedload more of everything. You can engage in a fleet battle that looks like two migrating ant hives colliding, even as a frankly unnecessary quantity of cyborgs pour over the forgeworld beneath and get their shit kicked in by some tornado-summoning sorcerers.

videos.summary: Celebrate 25 years of XBOX with an exclusive look at brand new Fable Quest Gameplay. The Hero of Briar Hill has entered the depths of Deepwood alongside Arden, a local Hero, to investigate why strange magical happenings have been troubling the people of Oakshire.
body: Fable launches on 23 February 2027 on XBOX Series X|S, Steam and PlayStation 5. You'll get up to 5 days Early Access with the Premium Edition which includes the Fable Digital Artbook & Soundtrack, the Fable: Order of the Hero expansion (coming post-launch) and the 'Premium Edition Content Pack’ which includes two cosmetic armour sets and in-game gifts.
